shortDescription: Exports the ASM policy from remote nodes.

options.name: base64
options.description: If C(true), the returned C(inline) ASM policy content will be Base64 encoded. Only applies to C(inline) ASM policy exports.

options.name: compact
options.description: If C(true), only the ASM policy custom settings will be exported. Only applies to XML and JSON type ASM policy exports.

options.name: dest
options.description: A directory where you want to save the policy file. This option is ignored when C(inline) is set to C(true).

options.name: file
options.description: The name of the file to be created on the remote device for downloading. When C(binary) is set to C(false), the ASM policy will be in XML format.

options.name: force
options.description: If C(false), the file will only be transferred if it does not exist in the the destination.

options.name: format
options.description: Defines the output format for the ASM policy to be exported. When C(json), the ASM policy will be in JSON format. When C(xml), the ASM policy will be in XML format. When C(binary), the ASM policy will be in binary format. When C(binary), inline export is not supported.

options.name: inline
options.description: If C(true), the ASM policy will be exported C(inline) as a string instead of a file. The policy can be be retrieved in the playbook C(result) dictionary under the C(inline_policy) key.

options.name: learning_suggestions
options.description: If C(true), JSON ASM policy with suggestions will be exported. Only applies to JSON type ASM policy exports.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the policy exported to create a file on the remote device for downloading.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition which contains the ASM policy to export.
